name: Zebra L10 ATEX (Windows)
statusNote: Zebra no longer sells the L10 Windows range; its ATEX versions aren't in Zebra's current range.
summary: The Zebra L10 ATEX (Windows) is the hazardous-area version of a Zebra rugged 10.1-inch tablet, certified for Zone 2/22 under ATEX and IECEx. It is an increased-safety (Ex ec) design running Windows 10 Pro. It has been discontinued.

otherSchemes: Meets IP54 and a 1 m drop to concrete in Ex mode
IP65, 1.8 m drop and -20 to +60 °C in non-hazardous locations (spec sheet)

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ec IIC T6 Gc / II 3D Ex tc IIIB T85°C Dc
atex.status: IECEx for Windows types not retrievable; the follow-on certificate TUR 19.0052X is Suspended (2026-03-06). ATEX status unknown.

iecex.marking: Ex ec IIC T6 Gc / Ex tc IIIB T85°C Dc
iecex.number: No IECEx certificate TUR 18.0036X in the public database. 18.0036 is IECEx test report DE/TUR/ExTR18.0036/00

certification.northAmerica: C1D2 versions of the L10 exist (separate hazardous-location SKU)

safety.conditions: Do not rub plastic parts or the display panel (electrostatic risk). Test level corresponds to low risk of mechanical danger: protect from mechanical danger. All I/O ports and the DC-in connector must not be used in the explosive atmosphere. Use in at least pollution degree 2 (IEC 60664-1). Charge only in the safe area. Hot-swap of the bridge battery only outside the hazardous location.
safety.peripherals: All I/O ports (USB, USB-C, RJ-45, HDMI/RS232, audio, micro SD, internal SIM) and DC-in must not be used in the explosive atmosphere.
safety.certifiedAccessories: Spec sheet: additional 36 Wh ATEX/IECEx standard battery (PN 450173), AC adapter (PN 450154 NA / 450042 EU), long active digitizer pen (PN 440036), short active pen with tether (PN 440037), screen protector (PN 400022). "Other L10 accessories not listed here are not compatible with L10 ATEX models" (no vehicle dock, keyboard or hard handle). The AC adapter is for the safe area only.

os.name: Windows
os.upgradeLimit: Windows 10 22H2 is the last Windows 10 version

specs.display: 10.1-inch Corning Gorilla Glass 3; View Anywhere 1000 nit; user-replaceable anti-glare protector
specs.outdoor: View Anywhere 1000 nit with night vision mode
specs.chip: Intel Core i5-8350U vPro (8th gen) or Pentium N4200
specs.hotSwap: Standard bridge battery, 1 minute swap time (outside hazardous locations)
specs.ports: 2 x USB 3.0, USB-C (DisplayPort out), RJ-45, 3.5 mm audio, HDMI or RS-232, dual nano-SIM, microSDXC; 1D/2D barcode (XPAD only); all barred from hazardous areas
specs.docking: Not for L10 ATEX (other L10 accessories incompatible)
specs.network: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth; optional Sierra EM7565 4G LTE with GNSS
specs.gnss: EM7565 (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, BeiDou) or u-blox GPS + GLONASS with SBAS
specs.touch: Auto-sensing standard, glove and wet touch
specs.ipRating: IP65 (non-hazardous locations); IP54 in Ex mode
specs.ruggedness: 1 m drop to concrete in Ex mode; 1.8 m outside (spec sheet)

strengths: ATEX and IECEx certified, with published certificate numbers
T6 temperature class, the strictest rating
limitations: No longer in the maker's current range
Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas
Dust group IIIB: combustible flyings and non-conductive dust only, not conductive dust
